title: Adani Energy Q2 profit up 148% on tax gain

timeline.title: Adani Energy Q2 profit up 148% on tax gain
timeline.line: Headline profit beat estimates, but a ₹1,274 cr tax write-back did most of the work
more: Net profit about ₹1,323 cr vs ₹534 cr a year ago
Revenue rose about 53%, while margins contracted
Stock closed down 2.2% at ₹1,295 on Oct 22

src.title: BusinessToday: Adani Energy shares fall despite 148% surge in Q2 net profit
